ranked.headline: Coupling structure across scales is being linked to emergent neural dynamics
ranked.summary: Explicit, testable inference of coupling across synaptic, population, and manifold levels is now being pursued with connectomes and bifurcation analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein interactions, binding affinity and structural disorder
ranked.summary: Sequence-based language models and graph networks now predict mutational, binding and disorder properties directly from protein data.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and mediation frameworks infer regulatory, inheritance and colocalisation…
ranked.summary: Pooled designs, trio structure and multi-dataset colocalisation are now being embedded in posterior-based inference for genetic and regulatory effects.

ranked.headline: Models infer cell-resolved tissue architecture from spatial and single-cell measurements
ranked.summary: Recent spatial and single-cell preprints add density-aware and Bayesian models for resolving tissue organization at cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods link gene regulation, chromatin loops and cell states
ranked.summary: Single-cell and multiomic frameworks now connect regulatory layers, cell states and longitudinal designs, including a maternal blood pregnancy atlas.

ranked.headline: K-mer methods on raw reads extend to phylogenetics, genetic codes, and mutation rates
ranked.summary: Recent publications and preprints apply k-mer statistics directly to raw reads for phylogeny, genome profiling, mutation rates, and genetic code inference.

ranked.headline: Simulation maps folding, binding, and free-energy landscapes beyond static structures
ranked.summary: Sampling-based methods now reach peptide folding, kinase binding pathways, and aptamer selectivity, moving beyond single static structures.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict regulatory activity from DNA and chromatin measurements
ranked.summary: Pretrained DNA embeddings and retrainable networks now link sequence to regulatory, epitranscriptomic and transposable element readouts.

ranked.headline: Graph and generative priors reshape single-cell representation learning
ranked.summary: Graph-based and Transformer models now encode dropout, cell-cell communication and spatial structure directly into single-cell latent representations.

ranked.headline: Computational models link mutation energetics to protein conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Preprints and one publication apply energetic, elastic-network, and AlphaFold analyses to predict mutation impact and complex accuracy.

ranked.headline: Comparative evaluation of ML models for biomarker, survival and sequence prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks feature selection and classifiers on omic, microbial, viral, and enzyme data, with protocols that vary across studies.

ranked.headline: Generalization of learned models across single-cell, cytometry, and cell painting data
ranked.summary: Preprints now evaluate biomedical models under distribution shift, missing modalities, and low supervision rather than single-dataset performance.

ranked.headline: Searchable resources probe microbial gene families for pathogen and antimicrobial targets
ranked.summary: Large metagenomic, pan-proteome, and genome collections are now packaged as queryable tools for gene- and protein-level analysis.

ranked.headline: Evaluating what multimodal fusion adds to cancer survival prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints probe whether added modalities truly improve survival models beyond C-index, via calibration and interaction analyses.

ranked.headline: Generative models steer biomolecule design toward explicit, controllable objectives
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair pretrained generative models with control or reward signals for multiobjective design of proteins, peptides, mRNA, and 3D molecules.

ranked.headline: Top TCR:pMHC methods reach macro-AUC near 0.60 on unseen peptides in IMMREP25
ranked.summary: IMMREP25 and new structure-informed models expose limited generalization of TCR specificity prediction to peptides absent from training data.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models capture hysteresis and bistability in disease trajectory data
ranked.summary: Latent-variable, Neural ODE and Koopman methods are now applied to longitudinal clinical and single-cell trajectory data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models couple cell-scale rules to spatial organization in tissues and…
ranked.summary: Calibrated mechanistic simulations are now being tied directly to measured spatial structure across cellular, tissue, and immune-population scales.

ranked.headline: Repurposed sequencing reads and new software refine microbial abundance and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints repurpose host WGS reads and introduce tools for binning, primer design, and long-read abundance and transcriptome analysis.

ranked.headline: Protein language models replace heuristics in FDR, EC prediction, and uncertainty
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test protein language models against BLAST, reversal decoys, and embedding uncertainty metrics.

ranked.headline: Modular software is making large biological datasets tractable across modalities
ranked.summary: Biological datasets routinely exceed system memory, so data access now constrains analysis more than model computation does.

ranked.headline: Autonomous agents orchestrate antibody and drug molecule design workflows
ranked.summary: Agentic control over design tools is moving from demonstration toward lab-validated and benchmarked evaluation in drug discovery.

ranked.headline: EEG features and virtual brain models track Parkinson's cortical network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair interpretable EEG features and generative virtual brain models with Parkinson's medication and neuromodulation outcomes.

ranked.headline: Machine learning for selection scans, sample geolocation and variant effect prediction
ranked.summary: Demographic confounding and data representation are becoming explicit modeling choices in learned selection and sample inference methods.

ranked.headline: Population-scale genomes are reshaping reference panels for imputation and matching
ranked.summary: Large diverse genome cohorts and pangenomes are being used to improve reference panels, imputation accuracy and donor matching.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies link plant genome structure to traits
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome-scale assemblies now extend from single reference genomes to multi-species frameworks for functional and evolutionary…

ranked.headline: Learned and physics-based models are being tested for transferable molecular energetics
ranked.summary: Learned potentials, ion force fields, and pKa predictors are now benchmarked against experimental data to test transferability beyond training conditions.

ranked.headline: MD and docking guide design of antibodies, receptor ligands, and GPCR constructs
ranked.summary: MD, docking, and in silico construct optimization are now applied directly to antibody formats, GPCR ligands, and cryo-EM target design.

ranked.headline: Representation and topology choices reshape inferred protein conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show that analytical representation and topology choices alter inferred conformational organization in MD and PDB-scale analyses.

ranked.headline: Learned models map heterogeneous biological data onto drug and antibiotic response
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair learned models with biological data for drug response, antibiotic mechanism, and uncertainty-aware prediction under distribution shift.

ranked.headline: Bridging identifiers, formats and annotations across genomic and proteomic resources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair identifier conversion, format bridging and annotation reuse with pathway, proteomics and variant-visualization tools.

ranked.headline: Graph, phylogenomic and deep-learning methods resolve genome evolution across taxa
ranked.summary: Pangenome graphs, phylogenomic sampling, and CNN-based introgression mapping now resolve lineage structure and hybridization in viral and eukaryotic genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational methods align spatial transcriptomics slices across diseases and platforms
ranked.summary: A 295-task benchmark and a graph-based slice aligner address spatial transcriptomics integration across diseases, platforms and conditions.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genomes enable demographic, comparative and sex-chromosome inference
ranked.summary: Single-individual and chromosome-level assemblies now yield population history, comparative evolution and sex chromosome calls from one genome.

ranked.headline: New tools for structure-guided ligand generation, simulation, and fragment prescreening
ranked.summary: April 2026 preprints and a published method pair de novo design servers with simulation and prescreening infrastructure for structure-based ligand discovery.

ranked.headline: Reference choice and error modelling shape detection of non-germline variants in…
ranked.summary: Pangenome references, STR-specific error models, and fragmentomics now target minority and non-germline variants in bulk and cfDNA sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Models recover single-cell state trajectories from snapshot and time-lapse data
ranked.summary: Snapshot single-cell measurements lack temporal order, motivating frameworks that reconstruct state dynamics from static or partial observations.

ranked.headline: Learned representations replace sequence comparison in homology search and annotation
ranked.summary: Structure- and embedding-based tools now target billion-sequence databases and annotation across the microbial tree of life.

ranked.headline: Software tools automate drift correction, detection and lineage tracking in microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method package drift correction, detection and tracking into reusable tools for time-series microscopy.

ranked.headline: Experiment-tailored spectral libraries and combinatorial PTM scoring refine MS proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent tools tailor in silico spectral libraries and per-PSM modification scoring to experiment-specific timsTOF DIA data and open-search PTM combinations.
